name: batione
description: BatiOne Construction — AI-assisted SaaS for construction professionals

scripts.build: npm run build -w @batione/shared && npm run build -w @batione/api && npm run build -w @batione/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @batione/api" "npm run dev -w @batione/web"
scripts.bootstrap: npm run infra:up && npm run build -w @batione/shared && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @batione/api && npm run lint -w @batione/web
